team.name: Anthea Tuazon
team.bio: A 3rd Year Student passionate about technology and continuous learning. Dedicated to explore innovative solutions and adapting to the ever-evolving digital world.

deliverables: A Foundation home page that explains the mission, programs, goals and ways to help
An About page introducing our group and how we worked
A donation page with a payment UI built on @stripe/react-stripe-js
Responsive layouts for phones, tablets and desktops
Keyboard-friendly navigation, visible focus states and readable color contrast

process.title: Research
process.detail: We studied how non-profit sites earn trust: a clear mission, open numbers, and one obvious way to give.

process.title: Design
process.detail: We chose a bridge-and-river theme, a calm teal and navy palette with a sun-yellow action color, and sketched each page on paper first.

process.title: Build
process.detail: We built the pages in React with shared components, so the foundation and About pages stay consistent.

process.title: Add payments
process.detail: We added Stripe’s PaymentElement through @stripe/react-stripe-js, with a small Express server that creates each payment securely.

process.title: Test and polish
process.detail: We tested on small screens, with the keyboard only, and with Stripe’s test cards, then fixed what felt confusing.

stack.name: React 19 and Vite
stack.use: App framework and fast development build

stack.name: React Router
stack.use: Foundation, About, Donate and confirmation pages

stack.name: @stripe/react-stripe-js
stack.use: Elements provider and PaymentElement for the donation form

stack.name: Express and Stripe Node SDK
stack.use: Creates payment intents on the server
